description: CPU socket must match the motherboard socket specification.
explanation: Attempting to install an incompatible CPU into a mismatched socket will physically bend pins or damage the motherboard socket.

description: RAM generation (DDR4 vs DDR5) must match the motherboard memory slots.
explanation: DDR4 and DDR5 memory modules have different physical notch positions and electrical pinouts; they cannot be interchanged.

description: CPU cooler mounting bracket must support the motherboard socket.
explanation: Cooler standoff mounting patterns differ between socket designs (e.g. LGA1700 vs AM5).

description: Total system estimated power consumption should not exceed 80% of rated PSU wattage.
explanation: Modern GPUs and CPUs have transient power spikes. Operating near 100% capacity triggers overcurrent protection (OCP) shutdowns.

description: Thermal paste must be applied between CPU and cooler prior to mounting.
explanation: Without thermal paste, air gaps trap heat, leading to rapid CPU thermal throttling within seconds and potential automatic thermal shutdown.

description: GPU physical length cannot exceed maximum chassis GPU clearance.
explanation: The graphics card will physically collide with front case intake fans or radiator brackets if it is too long.
